study.scope: Exploratory leave-one-original-training-recording-out audit on already inspected data from one person/session. Original validation and test files are excluded. Future shifts are noncausal diagnostic controls, not a formal null distribution.
study.label_access: Ridge and training median fit only other recordings. Prefix median receives eligible held-out labels strictly before 10 seconds. Only target reference validity enters the common scoring mask; shifted source reference labels are unnecessary.

integrity_definition: SHA-256 digests identify fits, prefix constants, full common target masks, and per-method predictions without publishing per-sample data.
